purpose: Close the missing non-software land-combat layer: artillery/mortars, infantry weapons, direct-fire/AT, mines/explosives, fortification materials, tactical communications hardware, engineer/mechanical plant, vehicles and ammunition/storage. Effects are bounded to repeatability, serviceability and prepared-position use; no new weapon family or quantity is created. This v046 form also defines the maturity clock needed for later event-by-event retroactive casualty correction without applying a blanket 1944 value to 1941-43 battles.
authority_note: TECH_INDEX_v009 remains authority. This overlay interprets existing compute/measurement/QC/logistics principles for land combat and explicitly preserves the prior rule that a universal Army-artillery hit-rate multiplier is not yet authorized.
causal_architecture: Domestic compute/measurement starts with firing tables, error decomposition and lot statistics before Europe missions.
Industrial/process gains reduce technical dispersion, reject bad lots and improve repair/serviceability; they do not increase nominal gun caliber, armor or explosive energy.
The strongest battlefield payoff occurs where targets/lanes are preregistered and communications survive; moving battles with broken observation receive much less benefit.

Europe/Yanagi is secondary for land weapons by Jan-1944. German precision-measurement/electronics experience can cross-feed test/calibration practice but does not create Japanese infantry/artillery weapon families.
Do not add these hardware effects again on top of existing soft C2/registered-fire/local-reserve effects; use stage-specific deltas only.

bands.label: 野砲・山砲・歩兵砲・迫撃砲の射表/弾道/照準・弾薬中央値
bands.hardware_unchanged: Existing gun and mortar families/counts, tube ballistics and shell energy remain historical/trace-bound.

working_effects.prepared_registered_position: time/rounds to useful fire roughly 8-15% lower when survey/observation/wire-radio survive
working_effects.first_effective_salvo_or_area_solution: roughly +8-15% relative technical effectiveness in a preregistered lane; not a casualty multiplier
working_effects.technical_dispersion_outlier_reduction: roughly 10-20% for controlled lots/known tubes after lot sorting, propellant-temperature and barrel-wear correction
working_effects.ammo_for_equivalent_suppression: roughly 8-15% lower under stable observation; collapses toward baseline if FO/comms are broken

limits: No effect if weapon destroyed/suppressed or observation is lost.
Counterbattery, smoke, terrain and crew quality remain dominant event variables.

bands.label: 擲弾筒・軽迫撃砲の照準表/弾薬lot/事前標定
limits: Human range estimation and battlefield obscuration still dominate unregistered targets.

bands.label: 小銃・軽重機関銃の製造中央値/照準零点/給弾・予備部品
bands.hardware_unchanged: Same weapon families, cyclic rates and cartridge energy; no extra machine-gun sections are created.

working_effects.technical_grouping_and_sight_zero: old provisional ceiling 5-15%; event use should remain below this
working_effects.prepared_position_useful_fire_persistenc: center roughly +3-7% relative where ammo/feed/spares survive

limits: Suppression, fatigue, visibility and training dominate actual hit rate.

bands.label: 20/37mm級・歩兵/高角砲の直射、対舟艇/対車両、局地装甲車両
bands.hardware_unchanged: Only historically/trace-valid guns and vehicles. No extra 47mm guns, tanks or heavier antitank weapons are spawned.

working_effects.sight_and_ammo_repeatability: roughly +5-12% relative technical repeatability at known lanes
working_effects.vehicle_serviceability_pre_bombardment: roughly +5-10% relative uptime where spares/fuel exist

limits: Does not turn 20/37mm-class weapons into reliable frontal M4 Sherman killers.
US LVT/LVT(A) remain more vulnerable than M4 at favorable geometry.
Pre-invasion bombardment can erase the benefit before contact.

bands.label: 地雷・爆薬・信管・障害物破壊資材
bands.hardware_unchanged: No minefield or explosive-stock quantity is created.

working_effects.technical_dud_or_outlier_reduction: roughly 10-20% relative for controlled factory lots/kept-dry stocks
working_effects.prepared_obstacle_charge_reliability: modestly improved through waterproofing, segregation and test rejection

limits: Coral, salt water, hurried emplacement and bombardment damage can overwhelm factory-quality gains.
No invisible naval minefield is inferred.

bands.label: 掩体・交通壕・revettment・小分散弾薬庫・blast protection
bands.hardware_unchanged: Same labor/material envelope. No deep cave/tunnel network and no untraced concrete-pillbox construction program.

working_effects.completed_earth_timber_protected_positio: roughly +10-20% local completion versus historical baseline where warning/material/time permit
working_effects.protected_crew_bombardment_survival: roughly 5-12% relative local casualty reduction for personnel actually inside completed positions
working_effects.catastrophic_store_chain_loss: lower probability through smaller magazines, blast separation and revetments

limits: Open coral terrain and multi-day 16-inch/air/artillery bombardment remain devastating.

bands.label: 野戦電話・無線・電池・交換部品・試験器材
bands.hardware_unchanged: No large increase in radio/telephone set count without a traced issue table.

working_effects.prepared_base_equipment_serviceability: roughly +10-15% relative for protected sets/circuits with batteries/spares
working_effects.repair_turnaround: fault isolation and modular spares reduce some avoidable dead-time

limits: Cable cuts, antenna destruction, power loss and RF jamming still break the network.
This hardware uptime underpins soft C2; do not add a second command multiplier.

bands.label: 工兵器材・牽引車・トラクター・ポンプ・発電機・軽機械
bands.hardware_unchanged: No extra engineer companies, tractors, trucks or construction battalions are created.

working_effects.physical_payoff: faster re-digging, ditch/obstacle work, firebreaks, runway/track clearing, water/ammunition movement

limits: Bombardment, fuel shortage and spare depletion dominate after sustained isolation.

bands.label: 弾薬lot分離・防湿包装・小分散保管・給弾
bands.hardware_unchanged: No ammunition tonnage increase is implied.

working_effects.median_round_reliability: bad lots are rejected/segregated more consistently
working_effects.survivability: smaller magazines and protected issue points reduce single-hit chain loss
working_effects.issue_efficiency: known lot/weapon pairing reduces avoidable correction and stoppage

limits: This overlaps with distributed-store process doctrine; count the physical survivability once, not as a second logistics bonus.

cross_theater_implications.atoll_defense: largest payoff in preregistered fire lanes, protected crews, communication uptime and reliable obstacles; still no depth against US combined arms
cross_theater_implications.burma_bengal: more useful over longer fronts because artillery/mortar corrections, engineer/vehicle uptime and ammunition issue can persist without total naval-fire dominance; must be event-audited separately
cross_theater_implications.china: artillery/engineer/logistics hardware/process may matter materially in sustained operations, but corps-level artillery concentration and transport remain separate gates
cross_theater_implications.home_islands_future: high-altitude air defense is not part of this land overlay; AA weapon/fire-control needs its own weapon-system audit before B-29 attrition is computed

anti_double_count: Do not add a global land-combat +X% multiplier.

The v044 ground-adaptation file already models command succession, local reserves, preregistration doctrine and distributed stores. Hardware overlay only changes whether existing weapons/positions/equipment execute those tasks reliably.
Landing-package gains affect deployment/availability of guns, radios, engineers and vehicles; once equipment is in position, do not add the same +15-25% again to weapon lethality.
TECH_INDEX_v009 remains authority; this does not silently close every Army-artillery weapon model.

maturity_by_period.artillery_ballistics_and_tables: MEDIUM_HIGH: prewar compute/firing-table work already pays; use lower half of mature prepared-fire bands unless unit has exceptional survey/observation support
maturity_by_period.ammunition_QC_small_arms_reliability: MEDIUM: factory lot rejection/zeroing/parts discipline exists but field feedback loop is not yet fully standardized
maturity_by_period.fortification_physical_standardization: LOW_MEDIUM: better drawings, revetment/store separation and materials accounting where preparation time exists; not a late-war island-defense system
maturity_by_period.tactical_comms_hardware_serviceability: LOW_MEDIUM: electrical QC helps, but spares/battery/fault-isolation system is not yet 1943-level
maturity_by_period.engineer_plant_vehicle_uptime: LOW_MEDIUM: maintenance/process gains present but dispersed field-service organization is immature
maturity_by_period.retro_rule: Never use Jan-1944 upper bands automatically for 1941-42. Apply only domain-specific early maturity.

maturity_by_period.artillery_ballistics_and_tables: HIGH for prepared units; lot/tube/temperature correction becoming repeatable
maturity_by_period.retro_rule: Effects become visible in prepared defenses and sustained campaigns but remain uneven by theater and supply state.
Use event-local upper-middle bands only when observation, logistics and preparation are traced.
This is the mature pre-Feb-1944 working state; still no global casualty or hit-rate scalar.

retroactive_accounting_guard.rule: Do not rewrite individual pre-v046 casualty ledgers now solely because this missing hardware layer was discovered. Reserve event-local correction for the next consolidated Allied death tally / casualty reconciliation.
retroactive_accounting_guard.prospective_rule: Any new land combat adjudicated after the 1944-02-06 18:00 working clock loads this hardware layer immediately.
